title: Safety and eKYC verification
intro: Complete the demo verification steps to experience the identity protection process for Locals on the platform.
demoNote: The steps below only simulate actions and results. Do not upload or submit a real citizen ID, no real NFC chip is read, no data is checked against the Ministry of Public Security/VNeID, no face is analyzed, and no legally valid digital signature is created.
doneDesc: Your account has the Verified status. This is a demo status, not an actual identity verification result.
consent: I confirm that I agree to complete the eKYC demo process and understand that the verification actions here are only simulated.
privacyNote: The demo does not store ID card images, chip data, face images or signatures. Only the demo completion status is updated on your account.

ocr.title: Optical Character Recognition (OCR)
ocr.description: Demo of reading and digitizing the information on the front and back images of the citizen ID card.
ocr.d1: Read the full name, date of birth and ID number.
ocr.d2: Read the place of origin, permanent residence and identifying features.
ocr.d3: Check the sample information across both sides of the document.
ocr.demo: Simulated extracting information from both sides of the ID card.

nfc.title: NFC chip reading
nfc.description: Demo of the process of reading information from the chip embedded in the ID card.
nfc.d1: Hold the ID card close to an NFC-enabled device.
nfc.d2: Simulate reading the chip data and encrypted information.
nfc.d3: Simulate the identity information matching step.
nfc.demo: Simulated the NFC chip reading process.

face.title: Face Matching
face.description: Demo of matching your face against the portrait photo on your identity document.
face.d1: Simulate capturing a face image from the camera.
face.d2: Simulate comparing the face with the photo on the document.

liveness.title: Liveness Detection
liveness.description: Demo of checking that a real person is present in front of the camera.
liveness.d2: Simulate a request to smile or turn your head.
liveness.d3: Simulate checking for still photos and replayed videos.

sign.title: E-Signature
sign.description: Demo of confirming agreement to the forms and terms on the platform.
sign.d1: Read the demo confirmation and terms.
sign.d2: Confirm your agreement to complete the process.
